Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest can vest too remotely under common-law RAP (church use plus age-25 class gift), so it is void and the friend holds fee simple absolute.

Q8166.reason: Maine’s ‘hitherto’ is a historical observation; the standard misunderstanding is reading the line as a prediction of future legal change.

Q5649.reason: Post-operative care requires continuous urine-output measurement, a standard contraindication to a catheter valve.
